description: A playful recommendation annotation layer. Flags films rated below 2.5 stars, exactly 2.5 stars, or exactly 3 stars (except Grand Theft Hamlet), plus listed directed works by Paul Thomas Anderson and Taika Waititi, while respecting explicit exclusions.

rules.low_rating_rule: Flag films Cherie rated below 2.5 stars.
rules.borderline_rating_rule: Flag films Cherie rated exactly 2.5 stars.
rules.director_rule: Flag all listed directed works by Paul Thomas Anderson and Taika Waititi, whether or not Cherie has watched or rated them.
rules.warning_text: Cherie does not like this film and will judge you if you watch it.
rules.recommendation_policy: Do not suppress recommendations solely because they are flagged. Show the disclaimer as a playful personal-opinion annotation.
rules.three_star_rating_rule: Flag films Cherie rated exactly 3 stars, except Grand Theft Hamlet.

source: Letterboxd ratings.csv supplied by the user; director filmography list retained from version 2. Three-star ratings were added from the supplied ratings export, excluding Grand Theft Hamlet.
